text.p: MoneyGram Payment Systems Inc, which completed an initial public offering on December 11, said on Tuesday it named James Calvano, 60, chairman and chief executive officer.
The company also said it named John Fowler, 47, chief financial officer.

First Data Corp previously owned both MoneyGram and Western Union, but the U.S. Federal Trade Commission said the company had to sell one unit because it could not own two competitors in the same industry.
A MoneyGram spokesman said most of MoneyGram's new executive appointees had already been with the company as either consultants or long-term employees, but had not had official titles.
Calvano, who had performed the duties of chairman before the IPO, was also formerly a senior executive at American Express Co.
Fowler has in the past held senior financial positions at Travelers Group Inc.
